raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly used death year as a proxy for longevity, assuming the person who died later necessarily lived longer. This ignored the differing birth years and led to the incorrect conclusion that Csaba Pálinkás lived longer. Properly computing lifespans shows Henry Scheffé (~70 years) outlived Pálinkás (~45 years).
